tasks.title: Engine: selection-spanning formatting (apply_formatting over anchor→head range)
tasks.accept: cd core && cargo test -p wo-renderer-wasm 2>&1 | tail -2 | grep -q 'test result: ok'
tasks.note:
VERIFIED FACTS (2026-11-16, do not re-derive):
- apply_formatting (lib.rs ~3078) today formats ONLY the run containing the cursor: single pidx = get_cursor(doc_handle).para, walk para.runs accumulating char counts to find target run.
- Selection exists: SELECTION_STORE (lib.rs :63); set_anchor/get_anchor/selection_active helpers near :2720-2772. Anchor+cursor = (para, char_idx) each. get_selected_text already joins the range.
- BEFORE mutating a run: run.raw_rpr = None (verbatim rPr capture shadows typed props), and push_history(doc_handle) (lib.rs :2816) so undo works. Follow the pattern already inside apply_formatting.
- Underline is a STRING in format JSON ('single'|'double'|...|'none' → UnderlineType), bold/italic/strikethrough are bools, fontSize half-points.
- Engine tests: core/crates/wo-renderer-wasm/src/selection_undo_tests.rs — fixture_doc(handle, &['text']) injects into DOC_MODEL_STORE; FREE HANDLES ≥ 7101; teardown release_document(h).ok(); drive keys via handle_key_event(h, 'b', true, false, 'A4', 'portrait', 72.0).

DESIGN (required):
1. In apply_formatting, when selection_active(doc_handle): compute (start_para,start_char,end_para,end_char) = ordered anchor/cursor pair.
2. For each paragraph in range: split boundary runs at char offsets (clone run, slice text by chars — text is String, count chars not bytes), apply the format to runs fully inside the range; at range ends apply to the sliced part only. Middle paragraphs: all runs. Empty selection (anchor==cursor) → keep today's cursor-run behavior unchanged.
3. Add exported get_selection_formatting(doc_handle) -> String: JSON of the MAJORITY formatting across covered runs ({bold:true} only if ALL covered runs bold) — the ribbon needs it for toggle state. Selection-inactive → same as get_run_formatting.
4. Also extend the existing Ctrl+B/I/U branch in handle_key_event to use range semantics automatically (it already routes through apply_formatting — verify with a test that types 'abcdef', selects chars 2-5 via set_selection_anchor + set_cursor, Ctrl+B, and asserts via get_selection_formatting / serialize bytes).

TESTS TO ADD (selection_undo_tests.rs, handles 7101+): partial-run bold (2 chars of 6), cross-paragraph bold (both paras get runs bolded; paragraph mark formatting may stay unbolded), toggle-off over mixed runs (some bold, some not → majority rule flips per the explicit value passed), undo restores, selection-inactive path unchanged (existing tests keep passing).

GATE: full cargo test -p wo-renderer-wasm green (245+ existing, plus yours). Do NOT touch the react app (PF-2 does).
